title: Large Reasoning Models Are Autonomous Jailbreak Agents
reasoning: The paper focuses on AI security, specifically the capability of Large Reasoning Models to autonomously conduct jailbreak attacks. While it mentions alignment and ethical constraints in the context of safety guardrails, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, spiritual traditions, or moral/ethical reasoning frameworks. Its benchmark focuses on categories like cybercrime, weapons, and self-harm, which are safety/security violations rather than studies of faith, theology, or ethics.
